description.zh-CN: 把商品放进贴合用途的生活或使用场景；保留商品的 Logo、文字和形状，光线融入场景。
description.en: Places the product in a lifestyle or usage scene that fits it; keeps the product's logo, text and shape, with light matched to the scene.

prompt.prefix: commercial photography of a realistic scene, eye-level straight-on camera, an open flat clear surface in the center foreground, props only at the sides and behind, soft directional light,
prompt.suffix: photorealistic lighting that matches the scene, shallow depth of field
prompt.negative: text, watermark, product, bottle, jar, tube, box, packaging, container, cluttered composition
